animal_cage.name: Animal Cage
animal_cage.shortDescription: A small cage for housing animals. Doesn't look particularly comfortable, but probably nicer than what some people have in the Lower Levels.

livestock_feed_dispenser.name: Livestock Feed Dispenser
livestock_feed_dispenser.shortDescription: A machine that blends food into stored calories for livestock.

auto_butcher.name: Auto Butcher
auto_butcher.shortDescription: A configurable auto butcher. It needs to be installed inside an Animal Cage or a RAS. Every night it harvests the animals that match its settings into its tray. It always ignores animals marked with the Marking Pen.
auto_butcher.flavorText: The mighty Gibber. Do not climb inside. Do not let anyone help you climb inside.

marking_pen.name: Marking Pen
marking_pen.shortDescription: Marks an animal or a fish with a colour. The Auto Butcher never touches a marked animal.

vacuum_robot.name: Cleaner Robot
vacuum_robot.shortDescription: Automatically collects Animal Feces from its surroundings during the night. Can also be activated manually for an immediate cleanup.

serum_red.name: Livestock Steroid Serum
serum_red.shortDescription: This serum will slightly boost an animal's growth rate, but at the cost of increased hunger and reduced immunity.

serum_green.name: Livestock Immunity Serum
serum_green.shortDescription: This serum will slightly boost an animal's immunity but at the cost of increased hunger

mouse_trap.name: Mouse Trap
mouse_trap.flavorText: Putting some cheese inside will probably help.

ras.name: Recirculating Aquaculture System
ras.shortDescription: A closed water loop for raising fish. Needs a water tank, power, and filters to keep the water clean.

ras_water_tank.name: RAS Water Tank
ras_water_tank.shortDescription: The water reservoir of a recirculating aquaculture system.

tilapia.name: Tilapia
tilapia.flavorText: Common farm fish. Grows fast, eats most things and breeds without much help.

tilapia_fry.name: Tilapia Fry
tilapia_fry.flavorText: Common farm fish. Grows fast, eats most things and breeds without much help.

gutter_tilapia.name: Gutter Tilapia
gutter_tilapia.flavorText: A sewer strain of tilapia. Grows slower and makes less meat for its feed, but dirty water does not bother it, and it takes heavy metal and chemical contaminants out of the tank while it lives there.

gutter_tilapia_fry.name: Gutter Tilapia Fry
gutter_tilapia_fry.flavorText: A sewer strain of tilapia. Grows slower and makes less meat for its feed, but dirty water does not bother it, and it takes heavy metal and chemical contaminants out of the tank while it lives there.

graft_tilapia.name: Graft Tilapia
graft_tilapia.flavorText: A modified tilapia. Makes less meat for its feed and needs clean water, but its skin can be sterilized and used as a bandage, and its unfertilized roe dresses a wound as it is.

graft_tilapia_roe.name: Graft Tilapia Roe
graft_tilapia_roe.flavorText: Graft tilapia eggs. Thick with the repair protein that makes the skin heal, which is why medics buy them by the clutch.

graft_tilapia_fry.name: Graft Tilapia Fry
graft_tilapia_fry.flavorText: A modified tilapia. Makes less meat for its feed and needs clean water, but its skin can be sterilized and used as a bandage, and its unfertilized roe dresses a wound as it is.

tilapia_skin_graft.name: Tilapia Skin Graft
tilapia_skin_graft.shortDescription: Sterilized skin of a graft tilapia. Stops the bleeding and closes a wound.

gutterflow_pellet.name: Gutterflow Pellet
gutterflow_pellet.shortDescription: Pressed gutter sludge. Cheap calories for omnivore fish, not for people.

industrial_fish_feed.name: Industrial Fish Feed
industrial_fish_feed.shortDescription: Mass produced factory-made feed for omnivore and herbivore fish.

eel.name: Eel
eel.shortDescription: Raised for its luxury fillets, worth far more than any other fish. Does not breed in captivity.

electric_eel.name: Electric Eel
electric_eel.shortDescription: A living generator. From adolescent on, it charges its tank's battery and every battery beside the tank each night, more as it grows. Does not breed in captivity.

sturgeon.name: Sturgeon
sturgeon.shortDescription: Farmed for caviar. Its eggs can be harvested using surgery tools while the fish is alive, or collected in full at slaughter. Does not breed in captivity.
